limitations: Local Development timings are not hosted SLO evidence or controlled A/B measurements.
Header wait combines network, gateway and database execution. Body timing combines body transfer/reading. JSON parsing and Postgres execution are not separately measured.
Summed concurrent request durations are not phase wall times.
The live snapshot digest binds hashes, version vectors and SOURCE_GAP lists; the UI digests hash rendered data. No raw salary or persona credential values are recorded.
